item.title: CATL and NIO sign a five-year partnership to develop battery technology
item.description: Chinese battery giant CATL and EV maker NIO have signed a five-year strategic cooperation agreement to develop battery technology, swapping network resources and global market share. item.description: WEX Fleet card now combines gasoline and public EV charging transactions into one card, one account, and one invoice.
